description: 创建一个 HTTP 或 HTTPS 短链。需要已注册账户。返回状态；链接为 active 时返回 Unicode 显示地址和 ASCII 地址。两条及以上请用 shorten_urls。重试同一操作须复用同一个 idempotency_key。 Create one HTTP or HTTPS short link. A registered account is required. Returns the state, and when active, the Unicode display URL and the ASCII URL. For two or more, use shorten_urls. A retry of the same operation must reuse the same idempotency_key.

alias.description: Optional custom path segment (stored lowercase). Do not send customSlug.

idempotency_key.description: Client-generated unique key for this create. Required. Replays within 24h.

locale.description: API language preference. Canonical values: en and zh-CN. Documented aliases normalized to the canonical value: zh-cn, zh-Hans, zh-hans, zh_Hans, zh_hans. Traditional Chinese is not supported. EN, ZH-CN, and bare zh are rejected. Omitted or blank defaults to en. This preference does not rewrite URL bytes, translate parameter names, or use the caller's location. Website routes stay /zh-cn.

title.description: Optional link title, at most 256 characters.

url.description: Destination HTTPS/HTTP URL to shorten. Required. Do not send longUrl.

name: shorten_url
title: Shorten URL · 缩短链接（短.在线）
